objective: Determine whether Bybit's own completed-bar last-price, mark-price, index-price and premium-index dislocations contain a structurally large after-cost directional payoff worth deeper reconstruction, without opening 2024 or later data.

economic_mechanisms.logic: A large last-price overshoot while mark remains close to index can be a transient execution-pressure state rather than a durable fair-value move.
When last, mark and premium point in the same direction and price is still moving with the dislocation, the state may represent durable leveraged demand rather than noise.
An extreme premium whose marginal change and last-price response reverse can mark exhausted leveraged pressure and convergence toward index.

data_contract.integrity: Every cached response is represented by a request-manifest hash; cached CSV bytes, source coverage and the common exact five-minute timeline are checksum-identified. Any common-timeline gap blocks economic interpretation.

causal_timing.signal_availability: Only after the full five-minute signal bar closes.
causal_timing.entry: Next exact five-minute Bybit last-price bar open.
causal_timing.exit: Next bar open after the completed pricing state converges or flips, unless an adverse stop is hit first.
causal_timing.same_bar_barrier_ordering: Protective stop is adverse and evaluated before any close-known state exit can execute.
causal_timing.gap_stop: A stop-crossing open exits at that worse open.
causal_timing.evaluation_boundary: Any still-open position is realistically liquidated at the final available development close solely to mark the account at the fixed evaluation boundary.

features.atr_bps: 24 completed five-minute bars of last-price true range divided by close

account_and_cost_contract.risk_quantity_rule: NAV risk budget divided by stop distance plus the selected all-in cost, capped by maximum notional leverage.
account_and_cost_contract.daily_growth_denominator: all UTC calendar days in the fixed stage
account_and_cost_contract.top_trade_removal: Remove the top ten percent of positive 12-bp account-PnL event keys before global slot competition and rerun the account.

conditional_next_stage.zero_survivors: Close this exact completed-five-minute formulation and return to a structurally different information source; keep 2024-2026 sealed.
conditional_next_stage.one_or_more_survivors: Before any ranking change, add exact Bybit BBO/depth, spread and latency, intratrade marked NAV, broader pre-2024 stability and only then freeze a sequential 2024 contract.

non_overlap: Prior Binance funding-settlement and cross-sectional funding studies used Binance premium/funding states, not Bybit-native last/mark/index execution dislocations.
The active USD-M dated-futures curve study uses Binance perpetual/current-quarter/next-quarter term structure.
The active cross-venue study uses local-arrival price discovery between Binance and Bybit.
This study does not use liquidation events, option surfaces, L2 maker queues, movement-hazard OCO orders or generic bar-pattern retuning.
prohibitions: No 2024, 2025 or 2026 request in the workflow.
No same-bar or favorable pre-signal entry.
No favorable missing-price fill or silent source-gap deletion.
No credentials, paper orders, testnet orders or live orders.
No rank promotion from this fatal screen.
